sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, World of War Hunters is a 2D platformer where you control a soldier tasked with taking down enemy installations. The gameplay mechanics are simple yet engaging, with a focus on action-packed shooting and quick reflexes. Your soldier can move left and right, jump, and shoot using one of several guns. Each gun has its own range, ammo capacity, and firing speed, making it essential to adapt your tactics to suit the situation. As you progress through the levels, the difficulty increases, and you'll need to rely on your skills and strategy to outmaneuver the enemy.

You'll need to choose the right gun for the job, taking into account its range, ammo capacity, and firing speed. With so many options available, you'll need to experiment to find the perfect combination that suits your playstyle.

Another essential aspect of World of War Hunters is its power-up system. You can collect power-ups to increase your score, ammo, or lives. These power-ups can be crucial in helping you overcome challenging levels and reach the next stage. You'll also need to keep an eye on your ammo and lives, as running out of either can lead to a game over.
